articles.제목: US maritime nuclear firm Bluecore Energy announces uranium purchase
articles.원문 요약: California-based Bluecore Energy said its purchase of low-enriched uranium from WMC is one of several areas where it has made "significant progress" towards moving its technology from engineering and non-fuelled hardware development toward fuel fabrication, testing, validation and future deployment.

articles.제목: Hot testing of Chinese SMR under way
articles.원문 요약: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation are reportedly taking place at the ACP100 small modular reactor demonstration project, under construction at the Changjiang site on China's island province of Hainan.

MHI delivers replacement steam generators for French reactor
articles.원문 요약: Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries has delivered a further three replacement steam generators to EDF. They are scheduled to be installed in unit 2 of its Cruas nuclear power plant in southeastern France.

Installation of the unit's 480 calandria tubes was completed faster than at Bruce 3 as the team carrying out the Major Component Replacement project continues to set new records for CANDU refurbishment.

articles.제목: US DOE funding to accelerate molten salt reactor development
articles.원문 요약: The Molten Chloride Reactor Experiment aims to achieve first criticality in 2027, with the US Department of Energy approving cost-shared funding under its Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program.

articles.제목: Joint venture formed for six-unit SMR plant in Poland
articles.원문 요약: Poland's SGE and ZE Pak have agreed to establish a joint venture to develop a nuclear power plant in Pątnów which will feature up to six BWRX-300 small modular reactors.

articles.제목: Newcleo opens MOX fuel development centre
articles.원문 요약: Innovative nuclear energy company Newcleo has inaugurated its EUR10 million (USD11 million) advanced nuclear fuel engineering, testing and training centre located in Chusclan, in the Gard department in southern France.
